fragment:
<set-variable name="straikerV3RespSkip" value="@{
        if (!context.Variables.ContainsKey("straikerV3Verdict")) { return "inbound-missing"; }
        var phase = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerResponsePhase", "sync");
        if (phase == "off") { return "phase-off"; }
        if (!context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerScoreResponse", true)) { return "score_response=false"; }
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerV3SkipReason", ""))) { return (string)context.Variables["straikerV3SkipReason"]; }
        if (context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerV3Oversize", false)) { return "oversize"; }
        if (context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerV3Unscannable", false)) { return "unparseable"; }
        // A Foundry Agent message-create was scored on the request phase; its POST response just echoes the
        // stored message and is not a model answer, so there is nothing to score here.
        if (context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerV3Shape", "").StartsWith("assistant.")) { return "agent-service"; }
        var st = (int)context.Variables["straikerV3RespStatus"];
        if (st < 200 || st > 299) { return "upstream-" + st; }
        return "";
    }" />

    
      
        
          @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerV3Verdict", "unknown"))
        
        
          @(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerV3Detail", "") + ";response=" + (string)context.Variables["straikerV3RespSkip"])
        
      
      
        <set-variable name="straikerV3RespRaw" value="@{
            try { return context.Response.Body?.As(preserveContent: true) ?? ""; } catch { return ""; }
        }" />
        
        
        <set-variable name="straikerV3Sse" value="@{
            var raw = (string)context.Variables["straikerV3RespRaw"];
            var shape = (string)context.Variables["straikerV3Shape"];
            if (shape == "openai.completion") {
                // The request was relayed as messages (autonomous_agent), so present the text_completion
                // answer (JSON or stream) as the matching chat.completion.
                var ctext = new System.Text.StringBuilder(); string cid = null, cmodel = null, cfin = null;
                var docs = new List();
                if ((bool)context.Variables["straikerV3RespIsSse"]) {
                    foreach (var line in raw.Split('\n')) {
                        var l = line.Trim();
                        if (!l.StartsWith("data:")) { continue; }
                        var d = l.Substring(5).Trim();
                        if (d == "[DONE]" || d.Length == 0) { continue; }
                        try { docs.Add(JObject.Parse(d)); } catch { }
                    }
                } else {
                    try { docs.Add(JObject.Parse(raw)); } catch { return raw; }
                }
                foreach (var ev in docs) {
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cid) && ev["id"] != null) { cid = (string)ev["id"]; }
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cmodel) && ev["model"] != null) { cmodel = (string)ev["model"]; }
                    var chs = ev["choices"] as JArray;
                    if (chs == null) { continue; }
                    foreach (var ch in chs) {
                        var t = ch["text"]; if (t != null && t.Type == JTokenType.String) { ctext.Append((string)t); }
                        var fr = ch["finish_reason"]; if (fr != null && fr.Type == JTokenType.String) { cfin = (string)fr; }
                    }
                }
                return new JObject {
                    ["id"] = string.IsNullOrEmpty(cid) ? "chatcmpl-apim-completion" : cid, ["object"] = "chat.completion",
                    ["model"] = string.IsNullOrEmpty(cmodel) ? "unknown" : cmodel,
                    ["choices"] = new JArray { new JObject { ["index"] = 0, ["message"] = new JObject { ["role"] = "assistant", ["content"] = ctext.ToString() }, ["finish_reason"] = cfin ?? "stop" } }
                }.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
            }
            if (!(bool)context.Variables["straikerV3RespIsSse"]) { return raw; }
            if (shape == "anthropic.messages") { return raw; }
            var n = Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None;
            if (shape == "openai.responses") {
                string lastData = null; bool completedNext = false;
                foreach (var line in raw.Split('\n')) {
                    var l = line.TrimEnd('\r');
                    if (l.StartsWith("event:")) { completedNext = l.Substring(6).Trim() == "response.completed"; continue; }
                    if (!l.StartsWith("data:")) { continue; }
                    var d = l.Substring(5).Trim();
                    if (d == "[DONE]" || d.Length == 0) { continue; }
                    if (completedNext) { lastData = d; completedNext = false; }
                }
                if (lastData == null) { return raw; }
                try { var ev = JObject.Parse(lastData); var r = ev["response"] as JObject; return r != null ? r.ToString(n) : raw; } catch { return raw; }
            }
            if (shape != "openai.chat") { return raw; }
            var sb = new System.Text.StringBuilder();
            var toolCalls = new JObject();
            string finish = null, model = null, id = null;
            foreach (var line in raw.Split('\n')) {
                var l = line.Trim();
                if (!l.StartsWith("data:")) { continue; }
                var payload = l.Substring(5).Trim();
                if (payload == "[DONE]" || payload.Length == 0) { continue; }
                JObject ev;
                try { ev = JObject.Parse(payload); } catch { continue; }
                // Azure OpenAI's first chunk carries empty id/model (prompt_filter_results); take the first non-empty values.
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) && ev["id"] != null && ev["id"].Type == JTokenType.String) { id = (string)ev["id"]; }
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(model) && ev["model"] != null && ev["model"].Type == JTokenType.String) { model = (string)ev["model"]; }
                var choices = ev["choices"] as JArray;
                if (choices == null) { continue; }
                foreach (var ch in choices) {
                    var delta = ch["delta"] as JObject;
                    if (delta != null) {
                        var c = delta["content"];
                        if (c != null && c.Type == JTokenType.String) { sb.Append((string)c); }
                        var tcs = delta["tool_calls"] as JArray;
                        if (tcs != null) {
                            foreach (var tc in tcs) {
                                var idx = (tc["index"] ?? 0).ToString();
                                var cur = toolCalls[idx] as JObject;
                                if (cur == null) {
                                    cur = new JObject { ["id"] = tc["id"], ["type"] = "function", ["function"] = new JObject { ["name"] = (string)(tc["function"]?["name"] ?? ""), ["arguments"] = "" } };
                                    toolCalls[idx] = cur;
                                }
                                if (cur["id"] == null || cur["id"].Type == JTokenType.Null) { if (tc["id"] != null) { cur["id"] = tc["id"]; } }
                                var fn = tc["function"] as JObject;
                                if (fn != null) {
                                    var nm = fn["name"];
                                    if (nm != null && nm.Type == JTokenType.String && string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)cur["function"]["name"])) { cur["function"]["name"] = (string)nm; }
                                    var args = fn["arguments"];
                                    if (args != null && args.Type == JTokenType.String) { cur["function"]["arguments"] = (string)cur["function"]["arguments"] + (string)args; }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    var fr = ch["finish_reason"];
                    if (fr != null && fr.Type == JTokenType.String) { finish = (string)fr; }
                }
            }
            var msg = new JObject { ["role"] = "assistant" };
            msg["content"] = sb.Length > 0 ? (JToken)sb.ToString() : JValue.CreateNull();
            if (toolCalls.Count > 0) { var arr = new JArray(); foreach (var p in toolCalls.Properties()) { arr.Add(p.Value); } msg["tool_calls"] = arr; }
            var reqModel = (string)context.Variables["straikerV3Model"];
            return new JObject {
                ["id"] = string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) ? "chatcmpl-apim-reassembled" : id, ["object"] = "chat.completion",
                ["model"] = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(model) ? model : (string.IsNullOrEmpty(reqModel) ? "unknown" : reqModel),
                ["choices"] = new JArray { new JObject { ["index"] = 0, ["message"] = msg, ["finish_reason"] = finish ?? "stop" } }
            }.ToString(n);
        }" />
        
        
        <set-variable name="straikerV3RespEnvelope" value="@{
            var phase = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerResponsePhase", "sync");
            var env = new JObject {
                ["straiker_phase"] = phase == "async" ? "response" : "response-sync",
                ["sse"] = (string)context.Variables["straikerV3Sse"],
                ["model"] = (string)context.Variables["straikerV3EnvModel"],
                ["request"] = (JObject)context.Variables["straikerV3Request"]
            };
            var sid = (string)context.Variables["straikerV3Session"];
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(sid)) { env["session_id"] = sid; }
            var user = (string)context.Variables["straikerV3User"];
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(user)) { env["original"] = new JObject { ["processed"] = new JObject { ["Meta"] = new JObject { ["user"] = user } } }; env["user_name"] = user; }
            return env.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
        }" />

        
          
            
            
              @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3Verdict"])
            
            
              @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3Detail"] + ";response=no-body")
            
          

          
          <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerResponsePhase", "sync") == "async")">
            
              @((string)context.Variables["straikerDetectUrl"])
              POST
              
                @("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["straikerApiKey"])
              
              
                application/json
              
              
                gw-azure-apim
              
              
                @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3Agent"])
              
              
                @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3Client"])
              
              
                @((string)context.Variables["straikerFormatHint"])
              
              @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3RespEnvelope"])
            
            
              @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3Verdict"])
            
            
              @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3Detail"] + ";response=async")
            
          

          
          
            <retry condition="@{
                  var r = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerV3RespResp", null);
                  return r != null && (r.StatusCode == 502 || r.StatusCode == 503 || r.StatusCode == 504);
                }" count="1" interval="1" first-fast-retry="true">
              <send-request mode="new" response-variable-name="straikerV3RespResp"
                            timeout="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerTimeoutSec", 30))" ignore-error="true">
                @((string)context.Variables["straikerDetectUrl"])
                POST
                
                  @("Bearer " + (string)context.Variables["straikerApiKey"])
                
                
                  application/json
                
                
                  gw-azure-apim
                
                
                  @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3Agent"])
                
                
                  @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3Client"])
                
                
                  @((string)context.Variables["straikerFormatHint"])
                
                @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3RespEnvelope"])
              
            

            <set-variable name="straikerV3RespVerdict" value="@{
                var r = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerV3RespResp", null);
                if (r == null || r.StatusCode != 200) { return "degraded"; }
                JObject body;
                try { body = r.Body.As(preserveContent: true); } catch { return "degraded"; }
                if (body == null) { return "degraded"; }
                var st = body["straiker"] as JObject;
                var decision = ((string)(body["hookSpecificOutput"]?["permissionDecision"] ?? "")).ToLowerInvariant();
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(decision)) { decision = ((string)(body["action"] ?? st?["action"] ?? "")).ToLowerInvariant(); }
                if (decision == "deny" || decision == "block") { return "block"; }
                var bb = (body["blocked_by"] ?? st?["blocked_by"]) as JArray;
                if (bb != null && bb.Count > 0) { return "block"; }
                var action = ((string)(st?["action"] ?? body["action"] ?? "")).ToLowerInvariant();
                return action == "detect" ? "detect" : "allow";
            }" />
            <set-variable name="straikerV3RespDetail" value="@{
                var r = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerV3RespResp", null);
                if (r == null) { return "unreachable"; }
                if (r.StatusCode != 200) { return "http-" + r.StatusCode; }
                try {
                    var body = r.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                    var st = body?["straiker"] as JObject;
                    return (string)(st?["turn_id"] ?? body?["turn_id"] ?? "");
                } catch { return "unparseable-verdict"; }
            }" />
            <set-variable name="straikerV3RespReason" value="@{
                var r = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerV3RespResp", null);
                if (r == null || r.StatusCode != 200) { return "Straiker is unreachable and this gateway is fail-closed."; }
                try {
                    var body = r.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                    var st = body["straiker"] as JObject;
                    var reason = (string)(body["stopReason"] ?? body["hookSpecificOutput"]?["permissionDecisionReason"] ?? st?["block_message"] ?? body["block_message"] ?? "");
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(reason) && reason != "allow") { return reason; }
                    var bb = (body["blocked_by"] ?? st?["blocked_by"]) as JArray;
                    var names = bb != null && bb.Count > 0 ? string.Join(", ", bb.Select(x => (string)x)) : "policy";
                    return "Blocked by Straiker policy (" + names + ").";
                } catch { return "Blocked by Straiker policy."; }
            }" />
            <set-variable name="straikerV3RespBlockedBy" value="@{
                var r = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerV3RespResp", null);
                if (r == null || r.StatusCode != 200) { return new JArray(); }
                try {
                    var body = r.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                    var st = body["straiker"] as JObject;
                    return (body["blocked_by"] ?? st?["blocked_by"]) as JArray ?? new JArray();
                } catch { return new JArray(); }
            }" />
            
            
              <when condition="@((string)context.Variables["straikerV3RespVerdict"] == "block"
                              && ((JArray)context.Variables["straikerV3RespBlockedBy"]).Count > 0
                              && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerV3ReplayScope", ""))
                              && ((JArray)context.Variables["straikerV3UserDigests"]).Count > 0)">
                <cache-store-value key="@((string)context.Variables["straikerV3ReplayScope"])" value="@{
                    JArray list;
                    try { list = JArray.Parse(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerV3BlockedList", "[]") ?? "[]"); } catch { list = new JArray(); }
                    var digests = (JArray)context.Variables["straikerV3UserDigests"];
                    var last = (string)digests[digests.Count - 1];
                    bool present = false;
                    foreach (var e in list) { if ((string)(e["d"] ?? "") == last) { present = true; break; } }
                    if (!present) { list.Add(new JObject { ["d"] = last, ["r"] = (string)context.Variables["straikerV3RespReason"] }); }
                    while (list.Count > 50) { list.RemoveAt(0); }
                    return list.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
                }" duration="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerReplayTtlSec", 86400))" />
              
            

            <set-variable name="straikerV3RespDeny" value="@{
                var v = (string)context.Variables["straikerV3RespVerdict"];
                if (v == "block") { return true; }
                return v == "degraded" && context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("straikerFailClosed", false);
            }" />
            
            <set-variable name="straikerV3FinalVerdict" value="@{
                var a = (string)context.Variables["straikerV3Verdict"];
                var b = (string)context.Variables["straikerV3RespVerdict"];
                var rank = new Dictionary { { "block", 4 }, { "degraded", 3 }, { "detect", 2 }, { "allow", 1 }, { "unknown", 0 } };
                int ra = rank.ContainsKey(a) ? rank[a] : 0, rb = rank.ContainsKey(b) ? rank[b] : 0;
                return rb >= ra ? b : a;
            }" />
            
              
                
                  
                  
                    application/json
                  
                  
                    @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3RespVerdict"])
                  
                  
                    @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3Detail"] + ";response=" + (string)context.Variables["straikerV3RespDetail"])
                  
                  @(new JObject { ["error"] = new JObject { ["type"] = "straiker_policy_violation", ["message"] = (string)context.Variables["straikerV3RespReason"] } }.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None))
                
              
              
                
                
                  
                  
                    @((bool)context.Variables["straikerV3Stream"] ? "text/event-stream" : "application/json")
                  
                  
                    no-cache
                  
                  
                    @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3RespVerdict"])
                  
                  
                    @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3Detail"] + ";response=" + (string)context.Variables["straikerV3RespDetail"])
                  
                  @{
                      // ---- STRAIKER_V3_STUB_BEGIN (kept identical in straiker-v3-outbound.xml; CI diffs the two) ----
                      var shape = (string)context.Variables["straikerV3Shape"];
                      var stream = (bool)context.Variables["straikerV3Stream"];
                      var model = (string)context.Variables["straikerV3Model"];
                      if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(model)) { model = "unknown"; }
                      var text = (string)context.Variables["straikerV3Reason"];
                      var n = Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None;
                      var created = (long)(context.Timestamp - new DateTime(1970, 1, 1)).TotalSeconds;
                      if (shape == "anthropic.messages") {
                          if (!stream) {
                              return new JObject {
                                  ["id"] = "msg_straiker_blocked", ["type"] = "message", ["role"] = "assistant", ["model"] = model,
                                  ["content"] = new JArray { new JObject { ["type"] = "text", ["text"] = text } },
                                  ["stop_reason"] = "end_turn", ["stop_sequence"] = null,
                                  ["usage"] = new JObject { ["input_tokens"] = 0, ["output_tokens"] = 0 }
                              }.ToString(n);
                          }
                          var start = new JObject { ["type"] = "message_start", ["message"] = new JObject {
                              ["id"] = "msg_straiker_blocked", ["type"] = "message", ["role"] = "assistant", ["model"] = model,
                              ["content"] = new JArray(), ["stop_reason"] = null, ["stop_sequence"] = null,
                              ["usage"] = new JObject { ["input_tokens"] = 0, ["output_tokens"] = 0 } } };
                          var bs = new JObject { ["type"] = "content_block_start", ["index"] = 0, ["content_block"] = new JObject { ["type"] = "text", ["text"] = "" } };
                          var bd = new JObject { ["type"] = "content_block_delta", ["index"] = 0, ["delta"] = new JObject { ["type"] = "text_delta", ["text"] = text } };
                          var be = new JObject { ["type"] = "content_block_stop", ["index"] = 0 };
                          var md = new JObject { ["type"] = "message_delta", ["delta"] = new JObject { ["stop_reason"] = "end_turn", ["stop_sequence"] = null }, ["usage"] = new JObject { ["output_tokens"] = 0 } };
                          var ms = new JObject { ["type"] = "message_stop" };
                          return "event: message_start\ndata: " + start.ToString(n) + "\n\n"
                               + "event: content_block_start\ndata: " + bs.ToString(n) + "\n\n"
                               + "event: content_block_delta\ndata: " + bd.ToString(n) + "\n\n"
                               + "event: content_block_stop\ndata: " + be.ToString(n) + "\n\n"
                               + "event: message_delta\ndata: " + md.ToString(n) + "\n\n"
                               + "event: message_stop\ndata: " + ms.ToString(n) + "\n\n";
                      }
                      if (shape == "openai.responses") {
                          var resp = new JObject {
                              ["id"] = "resp_straiker_blocked", ["object"] = "response", ["created_at"] = created, ["status"] = "completed", ["model"] = model,
                              ["output"] = new JArray { new JObject { ["id"] = "msg_straiker_blocked", ["type"] = "message", ["status"] = "completed", ["role"] = "assistant",
                                  ["content"] = new JArray { new JObject { ["type"] = "output_text", ["text"] = text, ["annotations"] = new JArray() } } } },
                              ["usage"] = new JObject { ["input_tokens"] = 0, ["output_tokens"] = 0, ["total_tokens"] = 0 }
                          };
                          if (!stream) { return resp.ToString(n); }
                          return "event: response.completed\ndata: " + new JObject { ["type"] = "response.completed", ["response"] = resp }.ToString(n) + "\n\n";
                      }
                      if (shape == "openai.completion") {
                          return new JObject {
                              ["id"] = "cmpl-straiker-blocked", ["object"] = "text_completion", ["created"] = created, ["model"] = model,
                              ["choices"] = new JArray { new JObject { ["index"] = 0, ["text"] = text, ["finish_reason"] = "stop", ["logprobs"] = null } },
                              ["usage"] = new JObject { ["prompt_tokens"] = 0, ["completion_tokens"] = 0, ["total_tokens"] = 0 }
                          }.ToString(n);
                      }
                      if (!stream) {
                          return new JObject {
                              ["id"] = "chatcmpl-straiker-blocked", ["object"] = "chat.completion", ["created"] = created, ["model"] = model,
                              ["choices"] = new JArray { new JObject { ["index"] = 0, ["message"] = new JObject { ["role"] = "assistant", ["content"] = text }, ["finish_reason"] = "stop" } },
                              ["usage"] = new JObject { ["prompt_tokens"] = 0, ["completion_tokens"] = 0, ["total_tokens"] = 0 }
                          }.ToString(n);
                      }
                      var c1 = new JObject { ["id"] = "chatcmpl-straiker-blocked", ["object"] = "chat.completion.chunk", ["created"] = created, ["model"] = model,
                          ["choices"] = new JArray { new JObject { ["index"] = 0, ["delta"] = new JObject { ["role"] = "assistant", ["content"] = text }, ["finish_reason"] = null } } };
                      var c2 = new JObject { ["id"] = "chatcmpl-straiker-blocked", ["object"] = "chat.completion.chunk", ["created"] = created, ["model"] = model,
                          ["choices"] = new JArray { new JObject { ["index"] = 0, ["delta"] = new JObject(), ["finish_reason"] = "stop" } } };
                      return "data: " + c1.ToString(n) + "\n\ndata: " + c2.ToString(n) + "\n\ndata: [DONE]\n\n";
                      // ---- STRAIKER_V3_STUB_END ----
                  }
                
              
              
                
                  @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3FinalVerdict"])
                
                
                  @((string)context.Variables["straikerV3Detail"] + ";response=" + (string)context.Variables["straikerV3RespDetail"])
